青山的一天(A Day at the green hill): 围绕自然环境的A1短文:介绍格蕾丝的日常、喜好与青山。
I am happy every day. Grace usually eats fish for lunch. We often go to the park together. We swam in the cool lake.
After school, we play together. Grace and Max are in the same class. The green hill is not far from my home. The rain stops at noon.
My friend Max is very kind. Grace drinks coffee every morning. I like my life very much.
